## MigrationRepository class

Tracks which migrations have run, in a table that lives alongside the application's own schema.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export declare class MigrationRepository 
```

## Remarks

[Migrator](./database.migrator.md) owns an instance and drives it; use this directly only to inspect or repair migration state — for example to mark a migration as applied after running its DDL by hand.

Every method except [MigrationRepository.ensureExists()](./database.migrationrepository.ensureexists.md) assumes the table exists.
